{{Quote|The Arrison's tell me you're a pretty good soldier. But before we get into officer training I need to see it for myself.|Sergeant Eom Nia, to an officer|<ref name="SWG:OM2" />}}
'''Eom Nia''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Non-commissioned officer/Legends|non-commissioned officer]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Nia was holding the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] and resided in [[Kaadara]].<ref name="SWG:OM2" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Sergeant Eom Nia undertook the supervision of a young [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]]<ref name="SWG:OM2" /> who had started officer training with [[Antom Moria]] on [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]],<ref name="SWG:OA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Officer|Officer Antom|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> and then with [[Ellis Arrison]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:OM1">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Officer|Officer Mission 1|Tatooine}}</ref> In order to train the cadet in leading soldiers into battle, Sergeant Nia ordered his trainee to attack the [[Mummer Cave]] in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] and kill a number of [[Mummers]]. The cadet eventually returned successful from the mission.<ref name="SWG:OM2">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Officer|Officer Mission 2|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Eom Nia was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:OM2" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Eom Nia was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
